OUR MISSION

A little knowledge.
A lifetime of smiles.

The Smile Initiative is dedicated to educating the public on oral health through prevention, education, and awareness.

We bring this mission to life by teaching kids directly, hosting sessions at community centers and libraries where we break down dental health into fun, accessible lessons.

We believe that when people understand why oral health matters, they're empowered to take better care of themselves for life.

OUR STORY

Big care.
Local beginnings.

We're here to make oral health education feel approachable, memorable, and fun.

Our work starts in familiar places: libraries and community centers. By meeting kids where they learn and play, we make space for questions, curiosity, and conversations about caring for their smiles.
